BiblicalUsage: The word is an opening, and its two uses open two different doors: the Levites lodged around the house of God because the opening of its gates every morning belonged to them, and Wisdom says the opening of her lips shall be right things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two openings belong together: gates opened for worship in the morning, and lips opened for truth through the day.
